description: AgentEvac is a Python simulator coupling SUMO road traffic with decision agents for wildfire evacuation. Its README documents package installation, interactive and headless runs, agent decision recording and replay, and options for warning and routing scenarios. Users supply a road network, hazard state, population agents and information conditions; outputs include departure timing, travel paths, exposure and travel-time measures. Geographic coverage depends on the supplied network and scenario. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing for code. Running live decision agents requires a separate OpenAI API key and service, while recorded decisions can be replayed without those calls. A limitation is that the README's behavioural design and performance claims were not independently tested, and an LLM response is not observed evacuation behaviour. The platform can compare warning and route policies under wildfire road closures. The catalogue's SUMO model provides the traffic engine, while this repository adds agent decisions and hazard coupling. No network archive, API credential or simulation output was downloaded. The related catalogue record model-sumo describes the traffic engine, while AgentEvac adds evacuation decisions and hazard scenarios.
name: AgentEvac wildfire evacuation simulator
